title.narrative: Building Resilience of Civil Society and Youth to COVID-19 in Gilgit-Baltistan and Chitral.

description.narrative: The overall objective of the action is to mitigate the socio-economic impact of COVID-19 by strengthening Civil Society, Entrepreneurs and empowering the Youth. The expected outcomes are: 1) CSOs actively engaged in delivering critical socio-economic services in response to COVID-19 outbreak. 2) Capacity of micro enterprises and farmer groups to withstand and adapt to the economic impact of COVID-19 and 3) Youth engagement enhanced in decision-making and leadership in civil society.
